clue.text: Leave sons drinking beer in trade events

parts.note: permission to leave, as given to an aircraft or ship

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son, twice
a type of beer

explanation.walkthrough: The ale sits between the two S's, and the whole follows CLEARANCE, the permission to depart.
explanation.definitionFit: Clearance sales are shop events selling off stock cheaply, a kind of trading occasion.

clue.text: Broken tea trolleys the French abandoned in Bury

the French masculine definite article, removed

explanation.definitionFit: To lay to rest is the idiom for burying a dead person, so it is a synonym for the verb.

clue.text: Cassiopeia's daughter is with capital attorney

clue.text: Movies edit out loud musical flourishes

clue.text: Plant stand supporting head of tulip

clue.text: Department I can ring up for meals on wheels provider
